mechanism.notes: plain spherical 3R (J1 / J2 / J3 O20 on MR117-2RS pairs) + K: link 1 split into 1a / 1b by a passive O20 hub (MR117 pair) on a 0.3 x 5 mm clock spring onto stop A, NOT sensed (K = law(q2)); slaved by a one-tooth Geneva drive: an MR63ZZ roller on an O3 dowel at the tip of a rigid tail of link 2 pushes one flank of a 6 mm lug on link 1a (the roller-flank contact = the 5th joint, 1 closed loop); 2 x O2 ISO 8734 stop dowels (K stop A, J2 folded / drive-end stops). Made: base adapter, link 1a + lug, link 1b, link 2 + tail, neck, 4 hub shafts, K cap with stop = 10; bought: 4 MR117 pairs (8), MR63ZZ, 2 dowels, clock spring = 12. Complexity 14.0 (tools/simplicity.py) vs the catalogue estimate 16.25.
